CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFPOP

CFPOP logs in to a POP3 mail server and returns the messages in the mailbox as a query, either just the headers or the whole message. It can also delete messages from the server.

Category

Internet protocols

Syntax

<CFPOP SERVER="servername"
    PORT="port_number"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    ACTION="action"
    NAME="query_name"
    MESSAGENUMBER="number"
    ATTACHMENTPATH="path"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    MAXROWS="number"
    STARTROW="number">

Attributes

SERVER
Required. Host name or IP address of the POP3 server.
PORT
Optional, default "110". POP3 port.
USERNAME
Optional. Mailbox user name.
PASSWORD
Optional. Mailbox password.
ACTION
Optional, default "GetHeaderOnly". GetHeaderOnly returns header fields only; GetAll returns headers and body; Delete removes the messages listed in MESSAGENUMBER.
NAME
Required for GetHeaderOnly and GetAll. Name of the query that receives the messages.
MESSAGENUMBER
Optional. Comma-separated list of message numbers to retrieve or delete. Required for Delete. When it is given, STARTROW and MAXROWS are ignored.
ATTACHMENTPATH
Optional. Directory for saving attachments. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
TIMEOUT
Optional, default "60". Seconds to wait for the server.
MAXROWS
Optional. Maximum number of messages to return.
STARTROW
Optional, default "1". First message number to return.

Usage

The query has the columns Date, From, MessageNumber, ReplyTo, Subject, CC, To and Header. With GetAll it also has Body, Attachments and AttachmentFiles. KoldFusion does not decode MIME attachments: the Body column holds the raw message text after the headers, and Attachments and AttachmentFiles are always empty.

If the server cannot be reached or rejects the login, an Application exception is thrown. Wrap CFPOP in CFTRY so a mail server that is down for the night does not take your page with it.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- There is probably no POP3 server on this machine; CFTRY keeps the page polite --->
<CFTRY>
  <CFPOP SERVER="127.0.0.1" USERNAME="someone" PASSWORD="secret"
         ACTION="GetHeaderOnly" NAME="Inbox" MAXROWS="10" TIMEOUT="10">
  <CFOUTPUT><P>#Inbox.RecordCount# message(s) waiting.</P></CFOUTPUT>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
  <TR><TH>##</TH><TH>From</TH><TH>Subject</TH><TH>Date</TH></TR>
  <CFOUTPUT QUERY="Inbox">
  <TR><TD>#MessageNumber#</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(From)#</TD>
      <TD>#HTMLEditFormat(Subject)#</TD><TD>#Date#</TD></TR>
  </CFOUTPUT>
  </TABLE>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Application">
    <CFOUTPUT>
    <P><B>No mail today.</B> #CFCATCH.Message#:<BR>
    <I>#CFCATCH.Detail#</I></P>
    </CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
